import r = "./rational.qui"
import lp = "./lp_parser.qui"
import tab = "./tableau.qui"

class Node(lp.Bound[] bounds, int depth, int | none parent, string branch, r.Fraction | none parent_value)
class Outcome(string status, tab.Result root, r.Fraction[] | none solution, r.Fraction | none objective, int nodes, int phase1, int phase2, int drives, string[] lines, string[] log)
    int pivots()
        return phase1 + phase2 + drives

int integer_count(const lp.Model model)
    count := 0
    for integer_variable := model.integers[]
        if integer_variable
            count += 1
    return count

string optional_text(const r.Fraction | none value)
    match value
        r.Fraction found
            return found.text()
        none
            return "-"

string parent_text(const int | none value)
    match value
        int found
            return string(found)
        none
            return "-"

tab.Result | error required_root(const tab.Result | none value)
    match value
        tab.Result found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing root LP")

Outcome solve(const lp.Model model, int limit, int level, func<tab.Result(lp.Model, lp.Bound[], int, int)> solve_lp)
    stack := [Node(model.bounds, 0, none, "root", none)]
    direction := if model.maximize then "maximize" else "minimize"
    lines := ["MODEL {model.name} {direction} integers {integer_count(model)} node_limit {limit}"]
    string[] log := []
    tab.Result | none root := none
    r.Fraction[] | none solution := none
    r.Fraction | none objective := none
    nodes := 0
    phase1 := 0
    phase2 := 0
    drives := 0
    incumbents := 0
    pruned := 0
    infeasible := 0
    status := ""
    while #stack != 0
        if nodes == limit
            status = "NODE_LIMIT"
            break
        node := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        nodes += 1
        tab.Result result := solve_lp(model, node.bounds, nodes, level)
        log = log.concat(result.log)
        if nodes == 1
            root = result
        phase1 += result.phase1
        phase2 += result.phase2
        drives += result.drives
        action := ""
        if result.status == "INFEASIBLE"
            infeasible += 1
            action = "infeasible"
        elif result.status == "UNBOUNDED"
            status = "UNBOUNDED"
            action = "unbounded"
        else
            prune := false
            match objective
                r.Fraction incumbent
                    prune = if model.maximize then result.value.compare(incumbent) <= 0 else result.value.compare(incumbent) >= 0
                none
                    prune = false
            if prune
                pruned += 1
                action = "pruned"
            else
                variable := -1
                for: position < int(#model.names)
                    if model.integers[position] and result.solution[position].denominator != 1
                        variable = position
                        break
                if variable < 0
                    solution = result.solution
                    objective = result.value
                    incumbents += 1
                    action = "incumbent"
                else
                    value := result.solution[variable]
                    down := r.Fraction(value.floor())
                    up := r.Fraction(value.ceil())
                    high := node.bounds
                    high[variable].lower = up
                    low := node.bounds
                    low[variable].upper = down
                    stack = stack.append(Node(high, node.depth + 1, nodes, "{model.names[variable]}>={up.text()}", result.value))
                    stack = stack.append(Node(low, node.depth + 1, nodes, "{model.names[variable]}<={down.text()}", result.value))
                    action = "branch {model.names[variable]} {value.text()}"
        lp_value := if result.status == "OPTIMAL" then result.value.text() elif result.status == "INFEASIBLE" then "infeasible" else "unbounded"
        lines = lines.append("NODE {nodes} depth {node.depth} parent {parent_text(node.parent)} branch {node.branch} lp {lp_value} pivots {result.pivots()} action {action}")
        if status == "UNBOUNDED"
            break
    if status == ""
        match solution
            r.Fraction[] found
                status = "OPTIMAL"
            none
                status = "INFEASIBLE"
    r.Fraction | none bound_value := objective
    if status == "NODE_LIMIT"
        backwards := stack[::-1]
        for node := backwards[]
            lines = lines.append("OPEN parent {parent_text(node.parent)} branch {node.branch} bound {optional_text(node.parent_value)}")
            match node.parent_value
                r.Fraction value
                    r.Fraction next_bound := value
                    match bound_value
                        r.Fraction old
                            if not ((model.maximize and value.compare(old) > 0) or (not model.maximize and value.compare(old) < 0))
                                next_bound = old
                        none
                            void
                    bound_value = next_bound
                none
                    bound_value = bound_value
    lines = lines.append("RESULT {status} objective {optional_text(objective)} nodes {nodes} incumbents {incumbents} pruned {pruned} infeasible {infeasible} open {#stack} bound {optional_text(bound_value)}")
    first := required_root(root)
    return Outcome(status, first, solution, objective, nodes, phase1, phase2, drives, lines, log)

import r = "./rational.qui"

class Problem(int line, string reason)
class Term(string name, r.Fraction coefficient)
class Constraint(int line, string name, Term[] terms, string comparison, r.Fraction rhs)
class BoundLine(int line, string name, string kind, r.Fraction | none lower, r.Fraction | none upper)
class Declaration(int line, string[] names)
class Parsed(string name, maximize := false, Term[] objective := [], Constraint[] constraints := [], BoundLine[] bounds := [], Declaration[] integers := [], Declaration[] binaries := [], Problem | none problem := none)
class Params(int level, int limit, map<string, int> levels, map<string, int> limits)
class BodyLine(int number, string text)
class Named(string name, Term[] terms)
class Bound(r.Fraction | none lower, r.Fraction | none upper)
class Model(string name, bool maximize, string[] names, r.Fraction[] costs, r.Fraction[][] matrix, r.Fraction[] rhs, string[] comparisons, string[] row_names, Bound[] bounds, bool[] integers)

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

bool name(string word)
    if word == "" or word[0].codepoints()[0] < 97 or word[0].codepoints()[0] > 122 or has(["bounds", "integer", "binary", "free", "inf"], word)
        return false
    for: 1 <= position < int(#word)
        character := word[position]
        if not ((character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57) or character == "_")
            return false
    return true

Term[] | none expression(const string[] words)
    Term[] terms := []
    position := 0
    sign := 1
    if #words > 0 and words[0] == "-"
        position += 1
        sign = -1
    while position < int(#words)
        variable := ""
        value := r.Fraction(1)
        match r.read(words[position])
            r.Fraction coefficient
                if position + 1 >= int(#words) or not name(words[position + 1])
                    return none
                variable = words[position + 1]
                value = coefficient
                position += 2
            none
                if not name(words[position])
                    return none
                variable = words[position]
                position += 1
        terms = terms.append(Term(variable, value.multiply(r.Fraction(sign))))
        if position == int(#words)
            return terms
        if words[position] != "+" and words[position] != "-"
            return none
        sign = if words[position] == "+" then 1 else -1
        position += 1
    return none

Named | none named(const string[] words)
    if #words < 2 or not words[0].ends_with(":")
        return none
    label := words[0][0:<int(#words[0]) - 1]
    if not name(label)
        return none
    match expression(words[1:<int(#words)])
        Term[] terms
            return Named(label, terms)
        none
            return none

Constraint | none constraint(const string[] words, int line)
    count := int(#words)
    if count < 4 or not has(["<=", ">=", "="], words[count - 2])
        return none
    match r.read(words[count - 1], true)
        r.Fraction rhs
            match named(words[0:<count - 2])
                Named value
                    return Constraint(line, value.name, value.terms, words[count - 2], rhs)
                none
                    return none
        none
            return none

bool present(const r.Fraction | none value)
    match value
        r.Fraction found
            return true
        none
            return false

BoundLine | none bound(const string[] words, int line)
    count := int(#words)
    if count == 2 and name(words[0]) and words[1] == "free"
        return BoundLine(line, words[0], "both", none, none)
    if count == 3 and name(words[0])
        r.Fraction | none value := r.read(words[2], true)
        if words[1] == ">=" and (present(value) or words[2] == "-inf")
            return BoundLine(line, words[0], "lower", value, none)
        if words[1] == "<=" and (present(value) or words[2] == "inf")
            return BoundLine(line, words[0], "upper", none, value)
        if words[1] == "=" and present(value)
            return BoundLine(line, words[0], "both", value, value)
    if count == 5 and words[1] == "<=" and words[3] == "<=" and name(words[2])
        r.Fraction | none lower := r.read(words[0], true)
        r.Fraction | none upper := r.read(words[4], true)
        if (present(lower) or words[0] == "-inf") and (present(upper) or words[4] == "inf")
            return BoundLine(line, words[2], "both", lower, upper)
    return none

Parsed parse(string model_name, const BodyLine[] body, int end_line)
    result := Parsed(model_name)
    state := "A"
    for line := body[]
        words := line.text.split(" ")
        accepted := false
        if state == "A"
            if line.text == "maximize" or line.text == "minimize"
                result.maximize = line.text == "maximize"
                state = "B"
                accepted = true
        elif state == "B"
            match named(words)
                Named value
                    result.objective = value.terms
                    state = "C"
                    accepted = true
                none
                    accepted = false
        elif state == "C"
            if line.text == "subject to"
                state = "D"
                accepted = true
        elif state == "D" or state == "E"
            if state == "E" and has(["bounds", "integer", "binary"], line.text)
                state = if line.text == "bounds" then "F" elif line.text == "integer" then "G" else "H"
                accepted = true
            else
                match constraint(words, line.number)
                    Constraint value
                        result.constraints = result.constraints.append(value)
                        state = "E"
                        accepted = true
                    none
                        accepted = false
        elif state == "F"
            if line.text == "integer" or line.text == "binary"
                state = if line.text == "integer" then "G" else "H"
                accepted = true
            else
                match bound(words, line.number)
                    BoundLine value
                        result.bounds = result.bounds.append(value)
                        accepted = true
                    none
                        accepted = false
        else
            if state == "G" and line.text == "binary"
                state = "H"
                accepted = true
            else
                valid_names := true
                for word := words[]
                    if not name(word)
                        valid_names = false
                if valid_names
                    if state == "G"
                        result.integers = result.integers.append(Declaration(line.number, words))
                    else
                        result.binaries = result.binaries.append(Declaration(line.number, words))
                    accepted = true
        if not accepted
            result.problem = Problem(line.number, "syntax error")
            return result
    if has(["A", "B", "C", "D"], state)
        result.problem = Problem(end_line, "syntax error")
    return result

Parsed[] read_models()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/models.lp"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    Parsed[] result := []
    current := ""
    BodyLine[] body := []
    for: position < int(#lines)
        line := lines[position]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        if current == ""
            words := line.split(" ")
            current = words[1]
            body = []
        elif line == "end"
            result = result.append(parse(current, body, position + 1))
            current = ""
        else
            body = body.append(BodyLine(position + 1, line))
    return result

Params read_params()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    first := lines[0].split(" ")
    second := lines[1].split(" ")
    level := int(first[1])
    limit := int(second[1])
    map<string, int> levels
    map<string, int> limits
    for: 2 <= position < int(#lines)
        if lines[position] == ""
            continue
        words := lines[position].split(" ")
        value := int(words[2])
        if words[0] == "log"
            .levels.set(words[1], value)
        else
            .limits.set(words[1], value)
    return Params(level, limit, levels, limits)

import r = "./rational.qui"
import lp = "./lp_parser.qui"
import tab = "./tableau.qui"
import simplex = "./simplex.qui"
import bnb = "./branch_bound.qui"

int variable_index(const string[] names, string sought)
    for: position < int(#names)
        if names[position] == sought
            return position
    return -1

r.Fraction[] coefficients(const string[] names, const lp.Term[] terms)
    values := array(#names, fill = r.Fraction(0))
    for term := terms[]
        position := variable_index(names, term.name)
        values[position] = values[position].add(term.coefficient)
    return values

bool inconsistent(const lp.Bound bound)
    match bound.lower
        r.Fraction lower
            match bound.upper
                r.Fraction upper
                    return lower.compare(upper) > 0
                none
                    return false
        none
            return false

r.Fraction | none rounded(const r.Fraction | none value, bool lower)
    match value
        r.Fraction found
            return r.Fraction(if lower then found.ceil() else found.floor())
        none
            return none

lp.Model | lp.Problem content(const lp.Parsed parsed)
    match parsed.problem
        lp.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            string[] names := []
            lp.Term[][] expressions := [parsed.objective]
            for row := parsed.constraints[]
                expressions = expressions.append(row.terms)
            for terms := expressions[]
                for term := terms[]
                    if not lp.has(names, term.name)
                        names = names.append(term.name)
            bounds := array(#names, fill = lp.Bound(r.Fraction(0), none))
            integers := array(#names, fill = false)
            string[] seen := []
            for row := parsed.constraints[]
                if lp.has(seen, row.name)
                    return lp.Problem(row.line, "duplicate constraint {row.name}")
                seen = seen.append(row.name)
            for line := parsed.bounds[]
                position := variable_index(names, line.name)
                if position < 0
                    return lp.Problem(line.line, "unknown variable {line.name}")
                if line.kind != "upper"
                    bounds[position].lower = line.lower
                if line.kind != "lower"
                    bounds[position].upper = line.upper
                if inconsistent(bounds[position])
                    return lp.Problem(line.line, "inconsistent bounds {line.name}")
            for line := parsed.integers[]
                for name := line.names[]
                    position := variable_index(names, name)
                    if position < 0
                        return lp.Problem(line.line, "unknown variable {name}")
                    integers[position] = true
                    bounds[position].lower = rounded(bounds[position].lower, true)
                    bounds[position].upper = rounded(bounds[position].upper, false)
                    if inconsistent(bounds[position])
                        return lp.Problem(line.line, "inconsistent bounds {name}")
            for line := parsed.binaries[]
                for name := line.names[]
                    position := variable_index(names, name)
                    if position < 0
                        return lp.Problem(line.line, "unknown variable {name}")
                    integers[position] = true
                    bounds[position] = lp.Bound(r.Fraction(0), r.Fraction(1))
            r.Fraction[][] matrix := []
            r.Fraction[] rhs := []
            string[] comparisons := []
            string[] row_names := []
            for row := parsed.constraints[]
                matrix = matrix.append(coefficients(names, row.terms))
                rhs = rhs.append(row.rhs)
                comparisons = comparisons.append(row.comparison)
                row_names = row_names.append(row.name)
            return lp.Model(parsed.name, parsed.maximize, names, coefficients(names, parsed.objective), matrix, rhs, comparisons, row_names, bounds, integers)

tab.Converted standard(const lp.Model model, const lp.Bound[] bounds)
    string[] columns := []
    tab.Substitution[] substitutions := []
    r.Fraction[] costs := []
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        bound := bounds[variable]
        tab.Part[] parts := []
        kind := ""
        offset := r.Fraction(0)
        match bound.lower
            r.Fraction lower
                parts = parts.append(tab.Part(int(#columns), r.Fraction(1)))
                columns = columns.append(model.names[variable])
                costs = costs.append(model.costs[variable])
                kind = "shift"
                offset = lower
            none
                match bound.upper
                    r.Fraction upper
                        parts = parts.append(tab.Part(int(#columns), r.Fraction(-1)))
                        columns = columns.append(model.names[variable] + "'")
                        costs = costs.append(model.costs[variable].negate())
                        kind = "reflect"
                        offset = upper
                    none
                        parts = parts.append(tab.Part(int(#columns), r.Fraction(1)))
                        columns = columns.append(model.names[variable] + "+")
                        costs = costs.append(model.costs[variable])
                        parts = parts.append(tab.Part(int(#columns), r.Fraction(-1)))
                        columns = columns.append(model.names[variable] + "-")
                        costs = costs.append(model.costs[variable].negate())
                        kind = "split"
        substitutions = substitutions.append(tab.Substitution(kind, offset, parts))
    variable_columns := int(#columns)
    rows := model.row_names
    comparisons := model.comparisons
    r.Fraction[][] matrix := []
    r.Fraction[] beta := []
    for: row < int(#model.matrix)
        entries := array(nat(variable_columns), fill = r.Fraction(0))
        rhs := model.rhs[row]
        for: variable < int(#model.names)
            rhs = rhs.subtract(model.matrix[row][variable].multiply(substitutions[variable].offset))
            for part := substitutions[variable].columns[]
                entries[part.column] = part.direction.multiply(model.matrix[row][variable])
        matrix = matrix.append(entries)
        beta = beta.append(rhs)
    upper_rows := array(#model.names, fill = -1)
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        if substitutions[variable].kind != "shift"
            continue
        match bounds[variable].upper
            r.Fraction upper
                upper_rows[variable] = int(#rows)
                rows = rows.append(model.names[variable] + ".ub")
                comparisons = comparisons.append("<=")
                entries := array(nat(variable_columns), fill = r.Fraction(0))
                entries[substitutions[variable].columns[0].column] = r.Fraction(1)
                matrix = matrix.append(entries)
                beta = beta.append(upper.subtract(substitutions[variable].offset))
            none
                upper_rows[variable] = -1
    signs := array(#rows, fill = r.Fraction(1))
    for: row < int(#rows)
        if beta[row].numerator < 0
            signs[row] = r.Fraction(-1)
            beta[row] = beta[row].negate()
            for: column < int(#matrix[row])
                matrix[row][column] = matrix[row][column].negate()
            comparisons[row] = if comparisons[row] == "<=" then ">=" elif comparisons[row] == ">=" then "<=" else "="
    initial := array(#rows, fill = -1)
    slacks := initial
    for: row < int(#rows)
        if comparisons[row] == "="
            continue
        column := int(#columns)
        columns = columns.append("s:" + rows[row])
        costs = costs.append(r.Fraction(0))
        for: other < int(#matrix)
            matrix[other] = matrix[other].append(r.Fraction(0))
        matrix[row][column] = r.Fraction(if comparisons[row] == "<=" then 1 else -1)
        slacks[row] = column
        if comparisons[row] == "<="
            initial[row] = column
    int[] artificial := []
    for: row < int(#rows)
        if comparisons[row] == "<="
            continue
        column := int(#columns)
        columns = columns.append("a:" + rows[row])
        costs = costs.append(r.Fraction(0))
        for: other < int(#matrix)
            matrix[other] = matrix[other].append(r.Fraction(0))
        matrix[row][column] = r.Fraction(1)
        initial[row] = column
        artificial = artificial.append(column)
    sign := r.Fraction(if model.maximize then -1 else 1)
    constant := r.Fraction(0)
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        constant = constant.add(model.costs[variable].multiply(substitutions[variable].offset))
    r.Fraction[] phase1 := []
    r.Fraction[] phase2 := []
    for: column < int(#columns)
        phase1 = phase1.append(r.Fraction(if lp.has(artificial, column) then 1 else 0))
        phase2 = phase2.append(sign.multiply(costs[column]))
    representation := tab.Standard(columns, rows, signs, initial, slacks, artificial, phase1, phase2, constant, sign, substitutions, upper_rows)
    return tab.Converted(representation, tab.Tableau(matrix, beta, initial))

r.Fraction[] recover(const tab.Standard representation, const r.Fraction[] columns, bool offset)
    r.Fraction[] result := []
    for variable := representation.substitutions[]
        r.Fraction value := if offset then variable.offset else r.Fraction(0)
        for part := variable.columns[]
            value = value.add(part.direction.multiply(columns[part.column]))
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

tab.Result solve_lp(lp.Model model, lp.Bound[] bounds, int node_number, int level)
    converted := standard(model, bounds)
    tab.Standard representation := converted.standard
    tab.Tableau state := converted.tableau
    log := ["SOLVE node {node_number} rows {#representation.rows} columns {#representation.columns} artificials {#representation.artificial}"]
    if level >= 1
        for: variable < int(#representation.substitutions)
            tab.Substitution substitution := representation.substitutions[variable]
            line := "MAP {model.names[variable]} {substitution.kind}"
            if substitution.kind != "split"
                line += " {substitution.offset.text()}"
                if substitution.kind == "shift"
                    match bounds[variable].upper
                        r.Fraction upper
                            line += " upper {upper.text()}"
                        none
                            line = line
            log = log.append(line)
        for: row < int(#representation.signs)
            if representation.signs[row].numerator < 0
                log = log.append("FLIP {representation.rows[row]}")
    phase1 := 0
    phase2 := 0
    drives := 0
    redundant := 0
    status := "OPTIMAL"
    infeasibility := r.Fraction(0)
    int | none unbounded := none
    if #representation.artificial > 0
        if level >= 1
            log = log.append("PHASE 1")
        if level >= 2
            log = log.concat(tab.display(state, "phase 1 start", representation.columns, representation.rows, representation.phase1, r.Fraction(0), r.Fraction(1)))
        int[] candidates := []
        for: column < int(#representation.columns)
            candidates = candidates.append(column)
        result := simplex.phase(&state, representation.phase1, candidates, representation.columns, representation.rows, r.Fraction(0), r.Fraction(1), level, &log)
        phase1 = result.iterations
        infeasibility = tab.value(state, representation.phase1)
        if level >= 1
            log = log.append("PHASE 1 END objective {infeasibility.text()} iterations {phase1}")
        if infeasibility.numerator > 0
            status = "INFEASIBLE"
            if level >= 2
                log = log.concat(tab.display(state, "final", representation.columns, representation.rows, representation.phase1, r.Fraction(0), r.Fraction(1)))
        else
            for: row < int(#representation.rows)
                if not lp.has(representation.artificial, state.basis[row])
                    continue
                entering := -1
                for: column < int(#representation.columns)
                    if not lp.has(representation.artificial, column) and state.matrix[row][column].numerator != 0
                        entering = column
                        break
                if entering >= 0
                    if level >= 1
                        log = log.append("DRIVE row {representation.rows[row]} enter {representation.columns[entering]} leave {representation.columns[state.basis[row]]}")
                    tab.pivot(&state, row, entering)
                    drives += 1
                else
                    redundant += 1
                    if level >= 1
                        log = log.append("REDUNDANT row {representation.rows[row]}")
    if status != "INFEASIBLE"
        if level >= 1
            log = log.append("PHASE 2")
        if level >= 2
            log = log.concat(tab.display(state, "phase 2 start", representation.columns, representation.rows, representation.phase2, representation.constant, representation.sign))
        int[] candidates := []
        for: column < int(#representation.columns)
            if not lp.has(representation.artificial, column)
                candidates = candidates.append(column)
        result := simplex.phase(&state, representation.phase2, candidates, representation.columns, representation.rows, representation.constant, representation.sign, level, &log)
        phase2 = result.iterations
        unbounded = result.unbounded
        match unbounded
            int column
                status = "UNBOUNDED"
                if level >= 1
                    log = log.append("UNBOUNDED enter {representation.columns[column]}")
            none
                status = "OPTIMAL"
        objective := representation.constant.add(representation.sign.multiply(tab.value(state, representation.phase2)))
        if level >= 1
            log = log.append("PHASE 2 END objective {objective.text()} iterations {phase2}")
        if level >= 2
            log = log.concat(tab.display(state, "final", representation.columns, representation.rows, representation.phase2, representation.constant, representation.sign))
    value := representation.constant.add(representation.sign.multiply(tab.value(state, representation.phase2)))
    columns := array(#representation.columns, fill = r.Fraction(0))
    for: row < int(#representation.rows)
        columns[state.basis[row]] = state.beta[row]
    solution := recover(representation, columns, true)
    reduced := tab.reduced(state, representation.phase1)
    r.Fraction[] multipliers := []
    if status == "INFEASIBLE"
        for: row < int(#representation.initial)
            column := representation.initial[row]
            multipliers = multipliers.append(representation.signs[row].multiply(representation.phase1[column].subtract(reduced[column])))
    r.Fraction[] ray := []
    rate := r.Fraction(0)
    match unbounded
        int column
            direction := array(#representation.columns, fill = r.Fraction(0))
            direction[column] = r.Fraction(1)
            for: row < int(#representation.rows)
                direction[state.basis[row]] = state.matrix[row][column].negate()
            ray = recover(representation, direction, false)
            for: variable < int(#model.names)
                rate = rate.add(model.costs[variable].multiply(ray[variable]))
        none
            rate = rate
    objective_text := if status == "OPTIMAL" then value.text() else "-"
    log = log.append("RESULT {status} objective {objective_text} phase1 {phase1} phase2 {phase2} drives {drives} redundant {redundant}")
    return tab.Result(representation, state, status, value, solution, phase1, phase2, drives, infeasibility, multipliers, ray, rate, log)

class Range(string lower, string upper)

r.Fraction | none raise_lower(const r.Fraction | none current, const r.Fraction candidate)
    match current
        r.Fraction found
            return if candidate.compare(found) > 0 then candidate else found
        none
            return candidate

r.Fraction | none lower_upper(const r.Fraction | none current, const r.Fraction candidate)
    match current
        r.Fraction found
            return if candidate.compare(found) < 0 then candidate else found
        none
            return candidate

Range interval(const r.Fraction value, const r.Fraction | none lower, const r.Fraction | none upper)
    low := "-inf"
    high := "inf"
    match lower
        r.Fraction found
            low = value.add(found).text()
        none
            low = "-inf"
    match upper
        r.Fraction found
            high = value.add(found).text()
        none
            high = "inf"
    return Range(low, high)

string[] sensitivity(const lp.Model model, const tab.Result result)
    tab.Standard representation := result.standard
    tab.Tableau state := result.tableau
    reduced_columns := tab.reduced(state, representation.phase2)
    int[] nonbasic := []
    for: column < int(#representation.columns)
        if not lp.has(state.basis, column) and not lp.has(representation.artificial, column)
            nonbasic = nonbasic.append(column)
    r.Fraction[] prices := []
    for: row < int(#model.matrix)
        prices = prices.append(representation.sign.negate().multiply(representation.signs[row]).multiply(reduced_columns[representation.initial[row]]))
    r.Fraction[] reduced := []
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        value := model.costs[variable]
        for: row < int(#model.matrix)
            value = value.subtract(prices[row].multiply(model.matrix[row][variable]))
        reduced = reduced.append(value)
    objective := r.Fraction(0)
    for: row < int(#model.matrix)
        objective = objective.add(prices[row].multiply(model.rhs[row]))
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        objective = objective.add(reduced[variable].multiply(result.solution[variable]))
    kind := if bnb.integer_count(model) > 0 then "relaxation" else "lp"
    string[] basis_names := []
    for column := state.basis[]
        basis_names = basis_names.append(representation.columns[column])
    primal := 0
    dual := 0
    for: row < int(#representation.rows)
        if not lp.has(representation.artificial, state.basis[row]) and state.beta[row].numerator == 0
            primal += 1
    for column := nonbasic[]
        if reduced_columns[column].numerator == 0
            dual += 1
    lines := ["MODEL {model.name} {kind} objective {result.value.text()}", "BASIS {basis_names.join(" ")}", "DEGENERACY primal {primal} dual {dual}", "DUAL objective {objective.text()}"]
    for: row < int(#model.matrix)
        r.Fraction[] rho := []
        fixed := false
        for: other < int(#representation.rows)
            value := representation.signs[row].multiply(state.matrix[other][representation.initial[row]])
            rho = rho.append(value)
            if value.numerator != 0 and lp.has(representation.artificial, state.basis[other])
                fixed = true
        ends := Range(model.rhs[row].text(), model.rhs[row].text())
        if not fixed
            r.Fraction | none lower := none
            r.Fraction | none upper := none
            for: other < int(#representation.rows)
                if rho[other].numerator > 0
                    lower = raise_lower(lower, state.beta[other].negate().divide(rho[other]))
                elif rho[other].numerator < 0
                    upper = lower_upper(upper, state.beta[other].negate().divide(rho[other]))
            ends = interval(model.rhs[row], lower, upper)
        lines = lines.append("CONSTRAINT {model.row_names[row]} price {prices[row].text()} rhs {model.rhs[row].text()} range {ends.lower} {ends.upper}")
    for: variable < int(#model.names)
        tab.Substitution substitution := representation.substitutions[variable]
        status := "basic"
        if substitution.kind == "split"
            basic := false
            for part := substitution.columns[]
                if lp.has(state.basis, part.column)
                    basic = true
            status = if basic then "basic" else "zero"
        elif not lp.has(state.basis, substitution.columns[0].column)
            status = if substitution.kind == "shift" then "lower" else "upper"
        elif substitution.kind == "shift" and representation.upper_rows[variable] >= 0
            upper_row := representation.upper_rows[variable]
            if not lp.has(state.basis, representation.slacks[upper_row])
                status = "upper"
        h := array(#representation.columns, fill = r.Fraction(0))
        for part := substitution.columns[]
            h[part.column] = representation.sign.multiply(part.direction)
        eta := tab.reduced(state, h)
        r.Fraction | none lower := none
        r.Fraction | none upper := none
        for column := nonbasic[]
            if eta[column].numerator > 0
                lower = raise_lower(lower, reduced_columns[column].negate().divide(eta[column]))
            elif eta[column].numerator < 0
                upper = lower_upper(upper, reduced_columns[column].negate().divide(eta[column]))
        ends := interval(model.costs[variable], lower, upper)
        lines = lines.append("VARIABLE {model.names[variable]} {status} value {result.solution[variable].text()} reduced {reduced[variable].text()} cost {model.costs[variable].text()} range {ends.lower} {ends.upper}")
    return lines

string range_text(const r.Fraction[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return "- -"
    low := values[0]
    high := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value.compare(low) < 0
            low = value
        if value.compare(high) > 0
            high = value
    return "{low.text()} {high.text()}"

string statistics(const lp.Model model)
    r.Fraction[] matrix_values := []
    r.Fraction[] objective_values := []
    r.Fraction[] rhs_values := []
    r.Fraction[] bound_values := []
    for row := model.matrix[]
        for value := row[]
            if value.numerator != 0
                matrix_values = matrix_values.append(value.magnitude())
    for value := model.costs[]
        if value.numerator != 0
            objective_values = objective_values.append(value.magnitude())
    for value := model.rhs[]
        if value.numerator != 0
            rhs_values = rhs_values.append(value.magnitude())
    for bound := model.bounds[]
        match bound.lower
            r.Fraction value
                if value.numerator != 0
                    bound_values = bound_values.append(value.magnitude())
            none
                bound_values = bound_values
        match bound.upper
            r.Fraction value
                if value.numerator != 0
                    bound_values = bound_values.append(value.magnitude())
            none
                bound_values = bound_values
    return "STATS nonzeros {#matrix_values} matrix {range_text(matrix_values)} objective {range_text(objective_values)} rhs {range_text(rhs_values)} bounds {range_text(bound_values)}"

int setting(const map<string, int> values, string key, int fallback)
    match values.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return fallback

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    lp.Parsed[] blocks := lp.read_models()
    params := lp.read_params()
    string[] iterations := []
    string[] solutions := []
    string[] sensitivity_lines := []
    string[] tree := []
    csv := ["model,status,objective,approx,relaxation,nodes,pivots"]
    statuses := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    totals := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    analyzed := 0
    integer_models := 0
    integer_nodes := 0
    limits := 0
    for block := blocks[]
        match content(block)
            lp.Problem problem
                statuses[4] += 1
                iterations = iterations.append("MODEL {block.name} error")
                solutions = solutions.concat(["MODEL {block.name}", "STATUS ERROR line {problem.line} {problem.reason}"])
                sensitivity_lines = sensitivity_lines.append("MODEL {block.name} skipped ERROR")
                csv = csv.append("{block.name},ERROR,-,-,-,0,0")
            lp.Model model
                integer_model := bnb.integer_count(model) > 0
                level := setting(params.levels, model.name, params.level)
                limit := setting(params.limits, model.name, params.limit)
                iterations = iterations.append("MODEL {model.name} level {level}")
                bnb.Outcome outcome
                if integer_model
                    outcome = bnb.solve(model, limit, level, solve_lp)
                else
                    root := solve_lp(model, model.bounds, 1, level)
                    r.Fraction[] | none solution := none
                    r.Fraction | none objective := none
                    if root.status == "OPTIMAL"
                        solution = root.solution
                        objective = root.value
                    outcome = bnb.Outcome(root.status, root, solution, objective, 1, root.phase1, root.phase2, root.drives, [], root.log)
                iterations = iterations.concat(outcome.log)
                root := outcome.root
                status := outcome.status
                status_index := if status == "OPTIMAL" then 0 elif status == "INFEASIBLE" then 1 elif status == "UNBOUNDED" then 2 else 3
                statuses[status_index] += 1
                totals[0] += outcome.nodes
                totals[1] += outcome.phase1
                totals[2] += outcome.phase2
                totals[3] += outcome.drives
                if integer_model
                    integer_models += 1
                    integer_nodes += outcome.nodes
                    if status == "NODE_LIMIT"
                        limits += 1
                    tree = tree.concat(outcome.lines)
                direction := if model.maximize then "maximize" else "minimize"
                solutions = solutions.concat(["MODEL {model.name} {direction} variables {#model.names} constraints {#model.matrix} integers {bnb.integer_count(model)}", statistics(model), "STATUS {status}"])
                objective_text := "-"
                approximate_text := "-"
                match outcome.objective
                    r.Fraction value
                        objective_text = value.text()
                        approximate_text = value.approximate()
                        solutions = solutions.append("OBJECTIVE {objective_text} approx {approximate_text}")
                    none
                        objective_text = "-"
                relaxation := "-"
                if root.status == "OPTIMAL"
                    relaxation = root.value.text()
                    if integer_model
                        solutions = solutions.append("RELAXATION {relaxation} approx {root.value.approximate()}")
                if root.status == "INFEASIBLE"
                    solutions = solutions.append("INFEASIBILITY {root.infeasibility.text()}")
                    for: row < int(#root.multipliers)
                        solutions = solutions.append("FARKAS {root.standard.rows[row]} {root.multipliers[row].text()}")
                r.Fraction[] | none values := outcome.solution
                if status == "UNBOUNDED"
                    values = root.solution
                match values
                    r.Fraction[] found
                        for: variable < int(#model.names)
                            solutions = solutions.append("VALUE {model.names[variable]} {found[variable].text()}")
                    none
                        solutions = solutions
                if status == "UNBOUNDED"
                    for: variable < int(#model.names)
                        solutions = solutions.append("RAY {model.names[variable]} {root.ray[variable].text()}")
                    solutions = solutions.append("RATE {root.rate.text()}")
                match outcome.solution
                    r.Fraction[] found
                        for: row < int(#model.matrix)
                            value := r.Fraction(0)
                            for: variable < int(#model.names)
                                value = value.add(model.matrix[row][variable].multiply(found[variable]))
                            margin := if model.comparisons[row] == "<=" then model.rhs[row].subtract(value) else value.subtract(model.rhs[row])
                            solutions = solutions.append("ROW {model.row_names[row]} {value.text()} {margin.text()}")
                    none
                        solutions = solutions
                if integer_model
                    solutions = solutions.append("NODES {outcome.nodes}")
                solutions = solutions.append("PIVOTS {outcome.pivots()}")
                if root.status == "OPTIMAL"
                    analyzed += 1
                    sensitivity_lines = sensitivity_lines.concat(sensitivity(model, root))
                else
                    sensitivity_lines = sensitivity_lines.append("MODEL {model.name} skipped {root.status}")
                csv = csv.append("{model.name},{status},{objective_text},{approximate_text},{relaxation},{outcome.nodes},{outcome.pivots()}")
    iterations = iterations.append("TOTAL solves {totals[0]} phase1 {totals[1]} phase2 {totals[2]} drives {totals[3]} pivots {totals[1] + totals[2] + totals[3]}")
    solutions = solutions.append("SUMMARY models {#blocks} optimal {statuses[0]} infeasible {statuses[1]} unbounded {statuses[2]} node_limit {statuses[3]} error {statuses[4]}")
    sensitivity_lines = sensitivity_lines.append("SUMMARY analyzed {analyzed} skipped {int(#blocks) - analyzed}")
    tree = tree.append("SUMMARY models {integer_models} nodes {integer_nodes} node_limit {limits}")
    write_output("iterations.txt", iterations)
    write_output("solutions.txt", solutions)
    write_output("sensitivity.txt", sensitivity_lines)
    write_output("bnb_tree.txt", tree)
    write_output("summary.csv", csv)

if main
    run_program()

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int gcd(int first, int second)
    left := absolute(first)
    right := absolute(second)
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return if left == 0 then 1 else left

class Fraction(int numerator, denominator := 1)
    local divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator /= divisor
    denominator /= divisor
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator

    Fraction add(const Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction subtract(const Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction multiply(const Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.numerator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction divide(const Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator)

    Fraction negate()
        return Fraction(-numerator, denominator)

    Fraction magnitude()
        return Fraction(absolute(numerator), denominator)

    int compare(const Fraction other)
        left := numerator * other.denominator
        right := other.numerator * denominator
        return if left < right then -1 elif left > right then 1 else 0

    int floor()
        return if numerator < 0 and numerator % denominator != 0 then numerator / denominator - 1 else numerator / denominator

    int ceil()
        return -negate().floor()

    string text()
        return if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

    string approximate()
        Fraction scaled := magnitude().multiply(Fraction(1000000)).add(Fraction(1, 2))
        rounded := scaled.floor()
        tail := string(rounded % 1000000)
        while #tail < 6
            tail = "0" + tail
        prefix := if numerator < 0 and rounded > 0 then "-" else ""
        return "{prefix}{rounded / 1000000}.{tail}"

bool digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: position < int(#text)
        if text[position].codepoints()[0] < 48 or text[position].codepoints()[0] > 57
            return false
    return true

Fraction | none read(string word, signed := false)
    sign := 1
    text := word
    if text.starts_with("-")
        if not signed
            return none
        sign = -1
        text = text[1:<int(#text)]
    slash := text.split("/")
    if #slash == 2 and digits(slash[0]) and digits(slash[1])
        denominator := int(slash[1])
        if denominator == 0
            return none
        numerator := int(slash[0])
        return Fraction(sign * numerator, denominator)
    dot := text.split(".")
    if #dot == 2 and digits(dot[0]) and digits(dot[1])
        numerator := int(dot[0] + dot[1])
        denominator := 1
        for: position < int(#dot[1])
            denominator *= 10
        return Fraction(sign * numerator, denominator)
    if digits(text)
        numerator := int(text)
        return Fraction(sign * numerator)
    return none

string[] texts(const Fraction[] values)
    string[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(value.text())
    return result

import r = "./rational.qui"
import tab = "./tableau.qui"

class Phase(int iterations, int | none unbounded)

Phase phase(tab.Tableau &state, const r.Fraction[] costs, const int[] candidates, const string[] columns, const string[] rows, const r.Fraction constant, const r.Fraction sign, int level, string[] &log)
    count := 0
    while true
        reduced := tab.reduced(state, costs)
        entering := -1
        for column := candidates[]
            if reduced[column].numerator < 0
                entering = column
                break
        if entering < 0
            return Phase(count, none)
        leaving := -1
        best_ratio := r.Fraction(0)
        for: row < int(#state.matrix)
            if state.matrix[row][entering].numerator <= 0
                continue
            ratio := state.beta[row].divide(state.matrix[row][entering])
            if leaving < 0 or ratio.compare(best_ratio) < 0 or (ratio == best_ratio and state.basis[row] < state.basis[leaving])
                leaving = row
                best_ratio = ratio
        if leaving < 0
            return Phase(count, entering)
        before := reduced[entering]
        previous := state.basis[leaving]
        tab.pivot(&state, leaving, entering)
        count += 1
        if level >= 1
            objective := constant.add(sign.multiply(tab.value(state, costs)))
            log = log.append("PIVOT {count} enter {columns[entering]} reduced {before.text()} leave {columns[previous]} row {rows[leaving]} ratio {best_ratio.text()} objective {objective.text()}")
